1
Nkyea
1Paulo, Kristo Yesu somafoɔ a wɔnam Nyankopɔn pɛ so afrɛ no, ne yɛn nua Sostene 2#1 Ko 6.11; Aso 9.14 de kɔma Nyankopɔn asafo a ɛwɔ Korinto, wɔn a wɔate wɔn ho wɔ Kristo Yesu mu afrɛ wɔn sɛ wɔmmɛyɛ ahotefoɔ, ne wɔn a wɔbɔ yɛne wɔn nyinaa Wura Yesu Kristo din wɔ mmaa nyinaa no; 3adom ne asomdwoeɛ a ɛfiri yɛn Agya Nyankopɔn ne Awurade Yesu Kristo nka mo.
Aseda
4Nyankopɔn adom a wɔde adom mo wɔ Kristo Yesu mu no nti, meda me Nyankopɔn ase daa wɔ mo ho, 5sɛ nnoɔma nyinaa mu, moanya mo ho wɔ ne mu, asɛnka ne nimdeɛ nyinaa mu 6sɛdeɛ Kristo adanseɛ no atim mo mu 7#Tito 2.13 amma adom akyɛdeɛ biara ammɔ mo, berɛ a moretwɛn yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo adiyie no; 8#Flp 1.6; 1 Te 3.13; 5.23 ɔno ara nso na ɔbɛhyɛ mo den akɔsi awieeɛ, na mo ho amma asɛm biara yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo da no. 9#1 Te 5.24 Onyankopɔn a wɔnam ne so afrɛ mo akɔ ne ba, yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo ayɔnkofa mu no yɛ ɔnokwafoɔ.
Mpaepaemu a ɛwɔ Asafo no mu
10 # Flp 2.2; 3.16 Na anuanom, menam yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo din so metu mo fo sɛ, mo nyinaa nyɛ anokorɔ, na mpaepaemu amma mo mu, na mmom moabɔ mu awie pɛyɛ adwene korɔ ne nsusuiɛ korɔ mu. 11Na me nuanom, Kloe fiefoɔ abɛyi me mo ho asotire sɛ, aperepereɛ wɔ mo mu. 12#1 Ko 3.4; Aso 18.24; 18.27; Yoh 1.43 Ɛne sɛ, mo mu biara ka sɛ: Me deɛ, mewɔ Paulo afa, anaasɛ me deɛ mewɔ Apolo afa, anaasɛ me deɛ mewɔ Kefa afa, anaasɛ me deɛ mewɔ Kristo afa. 13Wɔapaepae Kristo mu anaa? Paulo na wɔbɔɔ no asɛnnua mu maa mo, anaasɛ wɔbɔɔ mo asu hyɛɛ Paulo din mu anaa? 14#Aso 18.8; Rom 16.23 Meda Onyankopɔn ase sɛ mammɔ mo mu biara asu gye Krispo ne Gaio, 15na obi anka sɛ wɔbɔɔ mo asu hyɛɛ mankasa me din mu. 16#1 Ko 16.15; 16.17 (Ɛhee, afei nso mebɔɔ Stefana fiefoɔ asu; na nkaeɛ no deɛ, sɛ mebɔɔ obi asu a, mennim.) 17#Yoh 4.2; Mat 28.19; 1 Ko 2.4 Na Kristo ansoma me sɛ memmɛbɔ asu ara kɛkɛ, na mmom sɛ memmɛka asɛmpa no, ɛnyɛ nyansasɛnka mu, na Kristo asɛnnua no anyɛ kwa.
Kristo yɛ Onyankopɔn Nyansa ne ne Tumi
18 # 2 Ko 4.3; Rom 1.16 Na asɛnnua no ho asɛm yɛ nkwaseasɛm ma wɔn a wɔreyera, na yɛn a wɔregye yɛn nkwa no deɛ, ɛyɛ Nyankopɔn tumi. 19#Yes 29.14 Ɛfiri sɛ wɔatwerɛ sɛ:
Mɛsɛe anyansafoɔ nyansa,
na mɛma animdefoɔ nimdeɛ ayɛ kwa.
20 # Hiob 12.17 Onyansafoɔ wɔ he? Ɔtwerɛfoɔ wɔ he? Wiase kyinnyegyefoɔ wɔ he? Onyankopɔn nnanee wiase yi nyansa nkwaseasɛm anaa? 21#Mat 11.25 Na wiase amfa nyansa so anhunu Onyankopɔn wɔ Nyankopɔn nyansa mu nti, ɛsɔɔ Nyankopɔn ani sɛ ɔnam asɛnka no nkwaseasɛm so bɛgye wɔn a wɔgye die no nkwa. 22#Mat 12.38; Yoh 4.48; Aso 17.18; 17.32 Ɛfiri sɛ Yudafoɔ bisa nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ, na Helafoɔ nso hwehwɛ nyansa; 23#Rom 9.32; 1 Ko 2.14 na yɛn deɛ, yɛka Kristo a wɔbɔɔ no asɛnnua mu no ho asɛm; ɔyɛ suntidua ma Yudafoɔ, na ɔyɛ nkwaseasɛm ma amanaman mufoɔ. 24#1 Ko 1.18; Kol 2.3 Na wɔn a wɔafrɛ wɔn no deɛ, Yudafoɔ oo, Helafoɔ oo, saa Kristo yi yɛ Nyankopɔn tumi ne Nyankopɔn nyansa. 25Ɛfiri sɛ Nyankopɔn nkwaseasɛm wɔ nyansa kyɛne nnipa, na Nyankopɔn mmerɛyɛ yɛ den sene nnipa.
26 # Mat 11.25; Yoh 7.48; Yak 2.1-5 Na, anuanom, mpo monhwɛ mo frɛ no, sɛ ɛnyɛ honam fam anyansafoɔ bebree, ɛnyɛ atumfoɔ bebree, ɛnyɛ adehyeɛ bebree na wɔafrɛ wɔn, 27na mmom wiase nkwaseadeɛ na Onyankopɔn ayi sɛ ɔde bɛhyɛ anyansafoɔ aniwuo. Na wiase adeɛ a ɛyɛ mmerɛ na Onyankopɔn ayi sɛ ɔde bɛhyɛ deɛ ɛyɛ den no aniwuo. 28Na wiase nnoɔma a ɛmfra ne deɛ wɔmmuo na Onyankopɔn ahwɛ mu ayie, ne deɛ ɛnni hɔ, sɛ ɔde bɛtu deɛ ɛwɔ hɔ, 29#Rom 3.27; Efe 2.9 na honam biara anhoahoa ne ho n’anim. 30#Yer 23.5-6; 2 Ko 5.21; Yoh 17.19 Na Onyankopɔn mu na ɛfire na mowɔ Kristo Yesu mu, ɔno a wabɛyɛ nyansa a ɛfiri Nyankopɔn hɔ, ne tenenee, ahoteɛ ne ɔgyeɛ ama yɛn. 31#Yer 9.23-24 Sɛdeɛ wɔatwerɛ sɛ: Deɛ ɔhoahoa ne ho no, ma no nhoahoa ne ho Awurade mu.

pageProps.chapterText:
Paulo, Kristo Yesu somafoɔ a wɔnam Nyankopɔn pɛ so afrɛ no, ne yɛn nua Sostene de kɔma Nyankopɔn asafo a ɛwɔ Korinto, wɔn a wɔate wɔn ho wɔ Kristo Yesu mu afrɛ wɔn sɛ wɔmmɛyɛ ahotefoɔ, ne wɔn a wɔbɔ yɛne wɔn nyinaa Wura Yesu Kristo din wɔ mmaa nyinaa no; adom ne asomdwoeɛ a ɛfiri yɛn Agya Nyankopɔn ne Awurade Yesu Kristo nka mo.

Nyankopɔn adom a wɔde adom mo wɔ Kristo Yesu mu no nti, meda me Nyankopɔn ase daa wɔ mo ho, sɛ nnoɔma nyinaa mu, moanya mo ho wɔ ne mu, asɛnka ne nimdeɛ nyinaa mu sɛdeɛ Kristo adanseɛ no atim mo mu amma adom akyɛdeɛ biara ammɔ mo, berɛ a moretwɛn yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo adiyie no; ɔno ara nso na ɔbɛhyɛ mo den akɔsi awieeɛ, na mo ho amma asɛm biara yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo da no. Onyankopɔn a wɔnam ne so afrɛ mo akɔ ne ba, yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo ayɔnkofa mu no yɛ ɔnokwafoɔ.

Na anuanom, menam yɛn Awurade Yesu Kristo din so metu mo fo sɛ, mo nyinaa nyɛ anokorɔ, na mpaepaemu amma mo mu, na mmom moabɔ mu awie pɛyɛ adwene korɔ ne nsusuiɛ korɔ mu. Na me nuanom, Kloe fiefoɔ abɛyi me mo ho asotire sɛ, aperepereɛ wɔ mo mu. Ɛne sɛ, mo mu biara ka sɛ: Me deɛ, mewɔ Paulo afa, anaasɛ me deɛ mewɔ Apolo afa, anaasɛ me deɛ mewɔ Kefa afa, anaasɛ me deɛ mewɔ Kristo afa. Wɔapaepae Kristo mu anaa? Paulo na wɔbɔɔ no asɛnnua mu maa mo, anaasɛ wɔbɔɔ mo asu hyɛɛ Paulo din mu anaa? Meda Onyankopɔn ase sɛ mammɔ mo mu biara asu gye Krispo ne Gaio, na obi anka sɛ wɔbɔɔ mo asu hyɛɛ mankasa me din mu. (Ɛhee, afei nso mebɔɔ Stefana fiefoɔ asu; na nkaeɛ no deɛ, sɛ mebɔɔ obi asu a, mennim.) Na Kristo ansoma me sɛ memmɛbɔ asu ara kɛkɛ, na mmom sɛ memmɛka asɛmpa no, ɛnyɛ nyansasɛnka mu, na Kristo asɛnnua no anyɛ kwa.

Na asɛnnua no ho asɛm yɛ nkwaseasɛm ma wɔn a wɔreyera, na yɛn a wɔregye yɛn nkwa no deɛ, ɛyɛ Nyankopɔn tumi. Ɛfiri sɛ wɔatwerɛ sɛ:
Mɛsɛe anyansafoɔ nyansa,
na mɛma animdefoɔ nimdeɛ ayɛ kwa.
Onyansafoɔ wɔ he? Ɔtwerɛfoɔ wɔ he? Wiase kyinnyegyefoɔ wɔ he? Onyankopɔn nnanee wiase yi nyansa nkwaseasɛm anaa? Na wiase amfa nyansa so anhunu Onyankopɔn wɔ Nyankopɔn nyansa mu nti, ɛsɔɔ Nyankopɔn ani sɛ ɔnam asɛnka no nkwaseasɛm so bɛgye wɔn a wɔgye die no nkwa. Ɛfiri sɛ Yudafoɔ bisa nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ, na Helafoɔ nso hwehwɛ nyansa; na yɛn deɛ, yɛka Kristo a wɔbɔɔ no asɛnnua mu no ho asɛm; ɔyɛ suntidua ma Yudafoɔ, na ɔyɛ nkwaseasɛm ma amanaman mufoɔ. Na wɔn a wɔafrɛ wɔn no deɛ, Yudafoɔ oo, Helafoɔ oo, saa Kristo yi yɛ Nyankopɔn tumi ne Nyankopɔn nyansa. Ɛfiri sɛ Nyankopɔn nkwaseasɛm wɔ nyansa kyɛne nnipa, na Nyankopɔn mmerɛyɛ yɛ den sene nnipa.
Na, anuanom, mpo monhwɛ mo frɛ no, sɛ ɛnyɛ honam fam anyansafoɔ bebree, ɛnyɛ atumfoɔ bebree, ɛnyɛ adehyeɛ bebree na wɔafrɛ wɔn, na mmom wiase nkwaseadeɛ na Onyankopɔn ayi sɛ ɔde bɛhyɛ anyansafoɔ aniwuo. Na wiase adeɛ a ɛyɛ mmerɛ na Onyankopɔn ayi sɛ ɔde bɛhyɛ deɛ ɛyɛ den no aniwuo. Na wiase nnoɔma a ɛmfra ne deɛ wɔmmuo na Onyankopɔn ahwɛ mu ayie, ne deɛ ɛnni hɔ, sɛ ɔde bɛtu deɛ ɛwɔ hɔ, na honam biara anhoahoa ne ho n’anim. Na Onyankopɔn mu na ɛfire na mowɔ Kristo Yesu mu, ɔno a wabɛyɛ nyansa a ɛfiri Nyankopɔn hɔ, ne tenenee, ahoteɛ ne ɔgyeɛ ama yɛn. Sɛdeɛ wɔatwerɛ sɛ: Deɛ ɔhoahoa ne ho no, ma no nhoahoa ne ho Awurade mu.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
